name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Anders and Okafor, one goes with Navigator and the other with Technician.
12 ly goes with Botanist if and only if 12 ly does not go with Okafor.
Exactly one of these is true: Anders goes with Technician; Okafor goes with Navigator; Rios goes with 16 ly.

hints.text: Suppose Anders didn't go with Navigator — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Anders does not go with Navigator.
From the clue “Between Anders and Okafor, one goes with Navigator and the other with Technician” — Anders must go with Technician.
From the clue “Between Anders and Okafor, one goes with Navigator and the other with Technician” — Okafor must go with Navigator.
…but now the clue “Exactly one of these is true: Anders goes with Technician; Okafor goes with Navigator; Rios goes with 16 ly” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
